Title: A Little Life
Author: Hanya Yanagihara
My Review:
Really wanted to like this book and i thought i was in a place where I would enjoy it.

Firstly: Expectation
I was trying to not get too hyped up (which is frankly difficult to do with everyone saying its the greatest and/or most devestaing/moving book ever). But more importantly I was expecting this to be about a group of friends and their interactions and how their individual lives and life as a group changes over time. I was disappointed to find out that its really only about one persons childhood trauma and how this affects his life and his friends are just side characters. I mean willem is quite present but malcom and Jb just get some Exposition in the beginning and then basically vanish. And its honestly just quite frustrating to read about a person living through incredibly effed-up trauma and not accept any help from his friends until he opens up a little bit for the first time around page 400/450...

The biggest disappointment for me was the writing and the way the story is told. Everything is spelled out to the last detail. I dont have to feel with these characters because all their thoughts and feelings are just right there on the page. There are no secrets, no between-the-lines moments as everything that is hinted at in the beginning is described/spelled-out in all of its glorious detail throughout the book... And it's all packaged in long, very dense sentences, which meant that I made slow process and had to concentrate on every word, not to miss some information/detail/emotion/reaction.

Not sure if 1/5 is fully deserved but it's a maximum 2/5 for me
